# AUTO.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp4,837.0 against Rp3,220.0 (expected total return 58.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Autos, components & dealerships.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- Tax is applied to EBIT at a.tax_rate 12.5% (fcff formula ebit*(1-tax)), but the LK's 11.05% consolidated rate exists only because Rp1,176.9bn of associate income arrives net of tax and is modelled in other_nonop, outside
- The multiple-survival test is reported backwards. Section 4 says the terminal value implies an exit EV/EBITDA in the mid single digits, below the 6.2 times the peer set trades at. Terminal value is Rp23,553bn and FY2035E
- The EV/EBITDA leg is deliberately built on the wrong D&A the report says it corrected. Metric is Rp1,535.3bn = TTM EBIT Rp1,334.4bn (FY2025 1,265.9 less 9M2025 894.0 plus 9M2026 962.6) plus only Rp200.9bn of D&A. On the 

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
